title: humboltia ciliata
intro: Humboltia ciliata, commonly known as the hairy vine, is a plant species native to India. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety and stress, and providing relief from insomnia. The health benefits of Humboltia ciliata include its ability to act as a sedative and anxiolytic, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions of inducing relaxation and reducing muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
